title: Death Singer
description: Fan-made Minecraft texture pack featuring the Death Singer’s sword, inspired by Songs of War.
body:
## Death Singer’s Sword

Death Singer’s Sword is a fan-made Minecraft texture pack that replaces the default sword with the iconic blade of the Death Singer from Songs of War, while keeping all original gameplay mechanics intact.

## Features

• Replaces the standard sword with the Death Singer’s sword
• Lightweight and easy to install
• No changes to gameplay mechanics

## Compatibility

• Designed for Minecraft 1.21.4
• Should work with most versions above 1.16, though minor visual differences may occur

## About

This pack is a fan-made inspired by the series Songs of War, created to bring a dramatic, immersive weapon design into Minecraft. Perfect for fans of the series or anyone looking to add a bold, high-fantasy style to their world.
